base: selected20_final_v14_g17 (byte-identical copy; only object_poses.npz of changed episodes rewritten)
rule: Shipped variant-B rule, unchanged: per frame, soft trust-region weighted SE(3) mean of the base and the type's good families (B_work/rules.json). Weight exp(-d^2/2), d = max(dp/1.5cm, dr/15deg) vs the base, base weight 1; half-turn twins for sweeper/pieces; cups/lid position only. Spoon, blue cup, lid, piece_2: base. The same weights are applied to world_from_object and camera_from_object.
clock: Every family track is first mapped onto the v14 clock with the exact G15 operator the team used for the base: world = retime(G15 camera @ family camera_from_object, delta_ep), camera = retime(family camera_from_object, delta_ep) (streamG15/code/retime.py shift, out/sync_delta_t.json; ep20 piecewise 0.925/1.85). Checked: the same operator on v8_g10b reproduces v14_g17 exactly for every slot a rule touches (max abs diff 0). Missing family frames: B1 filled with the pre-G15 base, B2 weight 0 (mask carried through the shift).
